zh: 想讨厌全世界，却发现这个世界还有个你。
en: I tried to hate the whole world, then I remembered you.

zh: 如果爱是一本书，那你将是我的标题封面。
en: If love were a book, you would be my title page.

zh: 我们可以是彼此的第二颗心脏吗？
en: Can we be each other's second heart?

zh: 被你喜欢和喜欢你都好幸福。
en: Being loved by you and loving you are both pure happiness.

zh: 你是我今天最想见到的人。
en: You are the one I want to see most today.

zh: 慢慢来，比较快。
en: Take your time — slow is smooth, smooth is fast.

zh: 今天也要好好吃饭，好好睡觉。
en: Eat well and sleep well today, okay?

zh: 世界很大，但我的世界里有你就够了。
en: The world is big, but my world is complete with you in it.

zh: 累了就休息，我一直都在。
en: If you are tired, rest. I am always here.

zh: 你笑起来的样子，是我最喜欢的风景。
en: Your smile is my favourite scenery.

zh: 无论晴天雨天，我都想和你一起过。
en: Sunny or rainy, I want to spend the day with you.

zh: 我们一起把普通的日子过成诗。
en: Let us turn ordinary days into poetry.

zh: 今天的你，已经很棒了。
en: You have already done great today.

zh: 想到你，连风都是甜的。
en: Even the wind tastes sweet when I think of you.

zh: 你负责开心，我负责让你开心。
en: You take care of being happy; I will take care of making you happy.

zh: 早安，愿今天的世界对你温柔一点。
en: Good morning — may the world be gentle with you today.

zh: 晚安，做个好梦，梦里有我。
en: Good night, sweet dreams — with me in them.

zh: 两个城市，一颗心，我们慢慢熬。
en: Two cities, one heart — we will make it through, slowly.

zh: 距离只是数字，想念才是真的。
en: Distance is only a number; missing you is what is real.

zh: 你所有的努力，我都看在眼里。
en: I see every bit of effort you make.

zh: 别怕，天塌下来我陪你一起顶。
en: Do not be afraid — if the sky falls, we will hold it up together.

zh: 你不需要变得更好，才值得被爱。
en: You do not have to become better to deserve love.

zh: 今天的风很温柔，像你一样。
en: Today's breeze is gentle, just like you.

zh: 我们一起慢慢变老，好不好？
en: Let us grow old slowly together, okay?

zh: 忙的时候好好忙，累的时候好好歇，我一直支持你。
en: Work hard when you are busy, rest well when you are tired — I am always rooting for you.

zh: 世界再吵，我这边永远为你安静。
en: However noisy the world gets, my side is always quiet for you.

zh: 你的城市下雨了吗？我这边想你。
en: Is it raining in your city? It is missing you here.

zh: 下次见面，我要把这段时间的想念都还给你。
en: Next time we meet, I will give back all the missing you owe me.
